attributes.residual:
DC'S PARK STANDS, NOW ON THREE MEASURED BARS INSTEAD OF FOUR, AND THE PARK IS STRENGTHENED RATHER THAN WEAKENED BY THE DIRECTION WORK. BAR 2 (direction) IS GONE - `dominating_def_inverse` exists and is exercised by 18 tests. It does not help, for three separately measured reasons.

BAR A, THE POSITIONAL PAIR IS li AGAINST li. The aligned window reproduces DC's reading exactly: ours [0x1e0,0x1ec) = `li r31,0` / `addi r30,r31,0` / `stw r30,0(r29)`, target = `li r28,0` / `stw r28,0(r30)` / `li r31,0`. POSITIONALLY at +0x1e0 our word decodes ('li',31,0) and the target's decodes ('li',28,0) - two constant loads of the same constant into DIFFERENT registers, which is a register/immediate difference and not a form change at all. All three proof labels, including the new inverse one, are refused with the same message: `+0x1e0: target word 0x3b800000 is not a register copy`. The inverse arrow DC describes (ours `addi r30,r31,0` against target `li r28,0`) is a POST-PERMUTATION pairing, reachable only through a permutation that step 0 already refuses.

BAR B, THE DESTINATION MISMATCH IS UNCHANGED. Even granted the permutation, our word writes r30 and the target's writes r28, so the site is a form change AND a recolor at once - LZ's v2 requirement, still unbuilt. The new inverse mode enforces destination equality exactly as the three older modes do, and there is a regression test pinning this precise site (test_destination_mismatch_is_still_a_recolor, built from the real words 0x3bdf0000 and 0x3b800000).

BAR C, THE JUMPTABLE BAR, RE-MEASURED AND DECISIVE ON ITS OWN. +0x1e0 is confirmed a jumptable case-entry - _jumptable_targets on the object returns 19 targets and 0x1e0 is among them - so it is in entry_indexes, and prove_constant_source refuses independently of everything above with `+0x1e0 is a branch target: control can enter between the definition and the rewrite site`. This is a correct fail-closed refusal, not a gap: control really can arrive at +0x1e0 from the switch dispatch without passing the `li r31,0`, so the dominating definition does not dominate. NO PROOF MODE IN ANY DIRECTION CAN DISCHARGE AN OBLIGATION HERE, and reopening this would require weakening a guard rather than building a capability - which the WebFrank tool constraints forbid outright.

WHAT WOULD REOPEN IT, corrected from DC's v1. DC listed requirement (i) as 'a dominating-def proof that tolerates a jumptable case-entry site'. That phrasing invites a guard relaxation and should not be executed as written; the sound version is a proof that discharges the constant on EVERY predecessor edge including all 19 dispatch entries, which is a different and much larger analysis than the straight-line backward scan. Requirement (ii), the combined form-plus-recolor stage, is real, is the 91-site image-wide population, and remains the correct next postprocessor target - but on its own it is not sufficient here, because BAR C is independent of it. Nothing in this function is source-reachable and the TU flip remains blocked by it alone.
